name: Balkhu River Flash Flood
transcript: Water is rising fast, we are on the second floor, three people, one is elderly...
logisticsRisk: Bridge access road partially submerged. Air access required.

name: Sindhupalchok Landslide Blockage
transcript: The road is completely blocked, we hear cracking sounds above us, please hurry...
logisticsRisk: Ground team blocked. High wind, drone flight marginal.

name: Kathmandu Building Collapse
transcript: Someone is trapped under debris, we can hear them but can't reach...
logisticsRisk: Ground team route clear. Low risk.

name: Bhaktapur Market Fire
transcript: The whole stall row is burning, smoke is everywhere, people are trapped between shops...
logisticsRisk: Narrow alley blocks fire truck. Foot team only.

name: Pokhara Lakeside Flood
transcript: Small craft are flipping near the dock, two swimmers are being swept toward the outlet...
logisticsRisk: Air support needed, current too strong for swimmers.

name: Melamchi Valley Flooding
transcript: The whole riverbank community is underwater, we're stuck on a rooftop...
logisticsRisk: Only helicopter access possible, weather marginal.

name: Chitwan Forest Wildfire Spread
transcript: Fire has jumped the firebreak, wind is pushing it toward the village...
logisticsRisk: Evacuation route open but closing fast.

name: Gorkha Earthquake Aftershock Collapse
transcript: Another aftershock just hit, part of the school wall came down, kids are inside...
logisticsRisk: Structure unstable, ground team must wait for engineer clearance.

name: Birgunj Urban Flooding
transcript: Water is knee-deep and rising in the market area, an elderly man collapsed...
logisticsRisk: Road passable by high-clearance vehicle only.

name: Dolakha Highway Landslide
transcript: A bus is stuck right at the edge of the slide, passengers are afraid to move...
logisticsRisk: Slope still active, delay ground approach 10+ minutes.

name: Butwal Industrial Area Flood
transcript: Chemical smell in the water, workers are trapped on the factory roof...
logisticsRisk: Hazmat precautions required before ground entry.

name: Ilam Tea Estate Landslide
transcript: Half the hillside came down onto the workers' quarters, we can see people moving...
logisticsRisk: Terrain too steep for vehicles, foot team only.

name: Biratnagar Windstorm Structural Damage
transcript: The roof just tore off, we're exposed, wind is still very strong...
logisticsRisk: Drone grounded due to wind speed.

name: Nuwakot Riverside Flood
transcript: Livestock and people are both stranded on a shrinking patch of dry ground...
logisticsRisk: Air access clear, moderate wind.

name: Kavre Hillside Collapse
transcript: A whole section of the road gave way with two motorbikes on it...
logisticsRisk: Alternate road available, adds 15 minutes.

name: Jhapa Lowland Flash Flood
transcript: The water came up so fast we didn't have time to move the children first...
logisticsRisk: Air support needed, current moderate.

name: Rasuwa Avalanche Near Trail
transcript: A group of trekkers is buried, we can see one arm sticking out of the snow...
logisticsRisk: Weather closing in, narrow rescue window.

name: Lalitpur Old Building Partial Collapse
transcript: The upper floor caved into the one below, we hear tapping from inside...
logisticsRisk: Structure stable enough for cautious entry.

name: Dhading Bridge Washout
transcript: The bridge is gone, there's a family stranded on the far bank...
logisticsRisk: Only aerial route available.

name: Kathmandu Gas Leak Explosion Risk
transcript: There's a strong gas smell near the collapsed wall, we're afraid to use any lights...
logisticsRisk: No powered equipment allowed near site until cleared.
